column4: Deposit accounting drains the vault in Vault.sol
column5: Deposit accounting drains the vault -- Vault.sol deposit() adjusts the amount before it moves, rounding in the protocol favor and letting an attacker skim accumulated balances.
Mint rounding -- Vault.sol mint() floors division on every call so the caller systematically loses a wei per mint.
Swap seam -- Router.sol swap() trusts an external quote without validating the integration seam.
